repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: CA2 在心肌細胞中調節 intracellular pH 與 Ca²⁺ 動態，理論上 CA 抑制可減少 Ca²⁺ 超載誘發的肌纖維過度收縮。然而 HCM 核心機轉為肌節蛋白突變（MYH7/MYBPC3），與 CA 活性無直接關係。現有文獻均為心衰竭通論，非 HCM 特定研究。

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: Thin filament excess myopathy（NEB/ACTA1/TPM 突變）涉及肌節 thin filament 比例失衡，與 CA 抑制無直接機轉關聯。Acetazolamide 對某些先天性肌肉病（如 Andersen-Tawil 症候群）有效係透過穩定肌膜電位，機轉差異顯著。

predicted_indications.disease_name: hypertrophic cardiomyopathy due to intensive athletic training

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 運動誘發之生理性心肌肥厚為機械應力（mTOR/MAPK）訊號適應，非病理性 CA 失調所致。Acetazolamide 對生理性肥厚無已知調節機轉，TxGNN 分數可能反映與一般 HCM 的節點鄰近性而非真實機轉。
Tateyama 型遠端肌肉病變為 GNE 基因突變（UDP-GlcNAc 2-epimerase/ManNAc kinase），導致唾液酸合成缺陷與肌膜糖蛋白異常。與 CA 抑制毫無已知機轉交集，屬 TxGNN 知識圖譜拓撲鄰近效應產生的雜訊預測。
肝硬化性心肌病常合併代謝性鹼中毒與體液滯留，CA 抑制理論上可雙重獲益（利尿 + 糾正鹼中毒）。然而肝硬化患者腎前性氮血症風險高，且對利尿劑反應不可預測。目前無任何臨床試驗或文獻直接探討，僅屬機轉推測。

literature.title: Congenital hydrocephalus in a trisomy 9p gained child: a case report.
literature.abstract: Hydrocephalus caused by excessive liquor production due to choroid plexus hyperplasia is a rare condition that may necessitate unusual treatment paradigms. It can be seen in trisomy 9p where coexisting congenital heart disease additionally may complicate the therapeutic approach as illustrated in the current case report.

literature.title: A case of non-cardiogenic pulmonary edema provoked by intravenous acetazolamide.
literature.abstract: A 61-year-old man was diagnosed with severe chest trauma after a car accident and had had difficulty in weaning from a ventilator because of flail chest and dilated cardiomyopathy. On the 17th day in the intensive care unit, he received i.v. acetazolamide to increase urine output. One hour after the injection, he suddenly developed severe hypoxia. Chest radiography revealed a butterfly shadow. He received other diuretics and a vasodilator, which seemed slowly to resolve the respiratory failure.

clinical_trials.title: STAMCAR: A Prospective EC-IC Bypass Registry
clinical_trials.brief_summary:
A prospective registry evaluating the efficacy of EC-IC bypass in a subgroup of patients, specifically, patients with carotid occlusion and symptoms refractory to medical therapy and evidence for poor cerebrovascular reserve as evaluated by physiological testing (e.g. Diamox Challenge SPECT Scan). This subgroup includes:

1. Hospitalized unstable patient with crescendo or postural TIA's
2. Patients with multiple TIA's, limb-shaking TIA's, and/or cognitive decline despite medical therapy.

relevance.reasoning: EC-IC 旁路手術血管外科登錄研究（已撤回，n=0），與腸阻塞完全無關。疑為資料庫映射錯誤，不應計入證據。

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: ⚠️ CA 抑制可影響腸道平滑肌離子通道，導致腸蠕動下降（adynamic ileus）。PMID 19653068 和 PMID 13659695 均記錄 acetazolamide 誘發麻痺性腸阻塞的不良事件。此適應症的 TxGNN 預測為偽陽性，機轉方向與治療目的相悖，具主動安全疑慮。

predicted_indications.disease_name: glycogen storage disease due to acid maltase deficiency, late-onset

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 晚發型龐貝病（GAA 突變）為溶酶體糖原蓄積症，標準治療為酵素替代療法（alglucosidase alfa）。CA 抑制對溶酶體 pH 有理論影響，但無任何研究探討其於龐貝病的臨床效益，屬純計算預測。
腸道平滑肌病變所致假性阻塞涉及肌層退化，CA 抑制對此無已知療效。類比 intestinal obstruction 的安全訊號（PMID 19653068），acetazolamide 本身可誘發腸動力障礙，理論上可能加重此疾病，具主動安全疑慮。
